items.name: 🇺🇸 GIRLS' GENERATION — Yuri Is Now A Free Agent
items.title: GIRLS' GENERATION — Yuri Is Now A Free Agent
items.caption:
YURI mentioned she attended a meeting with GIRLS' GENERATION for an upcoming comeback. She described her life in Jeju as calm and independent while catching up with Gian84 on the show. GIRLS' GENERATION's YURI left SM Entertainment and is now a free agent. She shared this update while appearing on MBC's I Live Alone on Oct 30. She mentioned attending a group meeting for this before filming.

———

Source: OSEN
